label: Upload HUD duration (s)
description: Duration of NETWORM's native upload progress bar; separate from infection timing.

label: Network pre-scan radius (m)
description: Range for scanning loaded eligible NPCs before propagation.

label: Relay hop radius (m)
description: Maximum distance to select another eligible infected host.

label: Infection interval (s)
description: Delay between NETWORM propagation steps; smaller values increase load.

label: Maximum infection steps
description: Upper bound on propagation ticks during a single NETWORM upload.

label: Maximum affected targets
description: Upper bound on the number of entities affected per upload.

label: Maximum fanout per host
description: Upper bound on how many relay connections one host may create.

label: Club takeover
description: Large-area preset: 145m scan, 115m hops, 0.14s steps; higher performance cost.

label: Balanced
description: Restore the original default spread and upload settings.

label: Performance safe
description: Lower-load preset: 65m scan, 45m hops and 0.50s infection steps.

label: Get NetWatch Σ MK.1
description: Grants one Items.NESTCyberdeck each click. For use when a ripperdoc does not stock it. Make sure a save is loaded.
